description:
Welcome to the release of MKR MUSIC! 🎉

Crafted with a completely overhauled User Interface alongside massive underlying optimizations. Featuring Player v17 engine for significantly smoother audio transitions, offline history caching, customized mood summaries, and 9 selectable anime & minimal icons.

Please check out our Release Notes.

changelog.title: What's New in v7 Engine
changelog.description: The following major additions require Android 11+ to function efficiently. If you encounter any bugs, please use the in-app reporting tool.
items: Fully integrated SponsorBlock API natively without third-party redirects.
Brand new immersive Listen Together interface featuring dynamic glassmorphism.
Added Player v17 <small>(limited currently to portrait orientation)</small>.
Rebuilt the Miniplayer completely with Compose animations.
Added a new Remix Section dynamically injected onto the home screen.

changelog.title: Fixes & Optimizations
items: Removed legacy SimpleMusic API providers to improve launch times by <font color="#4CAF50">40%</font>.
Spoofed core app metadata to mimic standard web browsers for safer uninterrupted streaming.
Improved Musixmatch exact lyrics matching stability (thanks to johnpetersa19).
Fixed critical Spotify login failure loop.

changelog.title: Support the Developer
changelog.description: ViviMusic will always remain free and open-source. If you enjoy the countless hours poured into this app, consider supporting the development below ❤️️
